title.vi: 1. Search index và serving là scope riêng
title.en: 1. Indexing and serving are their own scope

paragraphs.vi: Bài Web Crawler tạo corpus; Autocomplete gợi ý query; bài này xây keyword search có ranked results, filters, snippets, pagination, updates/deletes và visibility SLO. Chọn corpus trước: public web cần spam/link/quality signals; internal/site/product search cần fields, ACL, facets và tenant routing. Không mặc định một ranking formula dùng tốt cho mọi sản phẩm. Hybrid/vector retrieval nối được pipeline nhưng không thay lexical correctness và authorization.
paragraphs.en: The crawler builds corpora and autocomplete suggests queries. This lesson designs ranked keyword results, filters, snippets, pagination, updates/deletes and visibility. Public web and private/product corpora require different signals, fields and permissions. Hybrid retrieval can join the pipeline without replacing lexical correctness or authorization.

paragraphs.vi: Chốt p99 latency theo query class, freshness từ source commit tới searchable result, result completeness và relevance metrics. Một illustrative 200 ms query target khác ingest freshness vài giây; write accepted, document retrievable by ID và keyword searchable là contracts khác nhau. Product cần nói partial results có được phép không và stale authorization/delete có được chấp nhận không.
paragraphs.en: Define latency by query class, source-to-visible freshness, completeness and relevance. Query latency differs from ingest freshness; accepted writes, ID lookups and searchable visibility are distinct contracts. Specify partial-result and authorization/deletion policies.

items.vi: Query intent, candidate recall và judged quality; không chỉ score cao.
items.en: Measure intent, candidate recall and judged quality rather than scores alone.
Track source, ingest, writer and reader states including deletes.

items.vi: Tail budgets, completeness và quyền hiện hành đi cùng results.
items.en: Pair tail budgets with completeness and current rights.

title.vi: 2. Fan-out nhân query work, replicas nhân storage
title.en: 2. Fan-out multiplies query work; replicas multiply storage

paragraphs.vi: Giả định một tỷ documents, text trung bình 10 KB: raw 10 TB thập phân. Chọn hypothetical primary index 3 TB để tính, không suy từ raw text vì stored fields, positions, analyzers, vectors, compression và mappings thay ratio. Nếu dùng 64 primary shards thì trung bình 46,875 GB/shard; một replica thêm mỗi primary cho tổng khoảng 6 TB index copies trước merge/rebuild/headroom. Shard-size heuristics không thay benchmark actual query/update distribution.
paragraphs.en: Assume a billion documents averaging ten KB, or ten decimal TB raw. A hypothetical three-TB primary index is a sizing input, not a guaranteed compression ratio. Sixty-four primaries average 46.875 GB each; one additional replica doubles copies to six TB before maintenance/reserves. Benchmark actual fields and workloads rather than treat shard-size heuristics as laws.

paragraphs.vi: Peak 10.000 queries/giây fan-out đủ 64 eligible shards tạo 640.000 shard requests/giây trước hedges. Tenant/time/routing pruning có thể giảm eligible set; replicas thường chia query load, không có nghĩa query phải hỏi mọi replica. At K=100/shard, 64 shards trả tối đa 6.400 candidates/query; mỗi candidate giả định 32 bytes thì khoảng 204,8 KB/query và 2,048 GB/s merge ingress tại peak, chưa protocol/features. Model rerank pool nhỏ hơn vẫn cần candidate recall đủ.
paragraphs.en: Ten thousand queries/second across sixty-four eligible shards produce 640,000 shard requests before hedges. Routing can prune shards, and replicas distribute load rather than all receive every query. At one hundred 32-byte candidates/shard, a query merges up to 6,400 candidates or 204.8 KB, about 2.048 GB/s at peak before overhead/features. Bounded reranking still needs adequate candidate recall.

paragraphs.vi: Indexing capacity cần update bytes/s, reader refresh cadence, merge amplification, deleted-doc pressure và full reindex coexistence. Small shards tăng scheduling/metadata/fan-out overhead; quá large shard làm recovery/rebalance lâu và query work nặng. Size theo measured heap, CPU, disk bandwidth, cache working set, failure-domain loss và repair time; document count alone không phản ánh postings/cardinality.
paragraphs.en: Indexing also needs update, refresh, merge, deletion and coexisting-reindex budgets. Small shards add overhead; large ones extend recovery and query work. Measure memory, CPU, I/O, working sets and repair times rather than count documents alone.

title.vi: 3. API trả visibility và completeness rõ

paragraphs.vi: Search request có query grammar/mode, filters, pagination/sort context và authenticated principal từ server-side session. Response có result IDs/versions, bounded snippets, next cursor, index/ranking generation và partial/missing-shard status. Không trust tenantId/ACL client tự đưa như quyền; server derives/enforces scope. Query timeout khác empty result: zero matches và failed shard không được gộp một status.
paragraphs.en: Requests define query/filter/sort contexts under server-derived principals. Responses include versions, bounded content, cursors, generations and completeness. Client-supplied scopes do not establish rights; distinguish empty matches from failed/incomplete retrieval.

paragraphs.vi: Index update/delete có stable document ID và monotonically interpreted source version hoặc comparable revision token. Accepted response mô tả durability boundary và optional visibility wait token; writer ACK không mặc định immediate search visibility. Bulk errors phân per-item, có bounded retry và order/version rules. Delete retention/rebuild protocol phải chống late stale upsert, nhất là sau tombstone cleanup.
paragraphs.en: Updates/deletes have stable IDs and comparable source versions. Acceptance declares durability separately from searchable visibility. Bulk operations have per-item errors, bounds and version-aware retries. Retention/rebuild policies prevent stale resurrection.

title.vi: 4. Hai pipelines chia sẻ versioned readers

paragraphs.vi: Query service parse/rewrite bounded query, derive permission/filter scope và check scoped cache. Coordinator route eligible shards, merge local candidates rồi bounded rerank/hydrate. Ingest/indexer apply source changes và publish reader generations; merge/lifecycle giảm segment overhead và reclaim old bodies. Evaluation theo cả query quality lẫn freshness/latency, không chỉ health endpoints.
paragraphs.en: Queries are bounded, scoped, routed and merged before reranking/hydration. Ingestion publishes versioned readers, while maintenance handles segments/reclamation. Evaluate relevance and freshness/latency in addition to process health.

paragraphs.vi: Sơ đồ có query/cache/update/delete/rebuild traces. Replica routing phải biết compatible reader/schema/sort semantics; failover hoặc reindex không tự cho phép mix incompatible scores/cursors. Một global coordinator có thể scale stateless nhưng response correctness vẫn phụ thuộc query context, authorized candidate pool và completeness policy.
paragraphs.en: Trace queries, cache hits, updates, deletes and rebuilds. Replica/schema/sort compatibility matters through failovers. Stateless coordinators still require coherent contexts, authorized candidates and explicit completeness.

paragraphs.vi: Inverted index map term tới sorted doc IDs, term frequency và optional positions/offsets. AND query intersect posting lists, thường bắt đầu rare list rồi skip/block structures; OR hợp lists và score candidates. Phrase/proximity cần positions, không chỉ cả hai từ có trong document. Term dictionary/FST giúp lookup/prefix; stored fields phục vụ retrieval/snippets; doc values là column-oriented access cho sorting/facets/features. Query còn có thể đọc field data cho scoring/filter, không chỉ đọc documents khi làm snippet.
paragraphs.en: Postings map terms to sorted documents, frequencies and optional positions/offsets. Intersections/unions retrieve candidates; phrase/proximity queries require positions. Dictionaries assist lookup, stored fields hydrate content and columnar doc values support sorting/facets/features. Scoring/filtering can require additional document-field work.

paragraphs.vi: Index/query analysis phải tương thích, không nhất thiết byte-identical: query-time synonym expansion hoặc dedicated search analyzer có thể khác có chủ đích. Chốt Unicode normalization, accents, token boundaries, language stemming, stopwords và keyword fields. Tiếng Việt có segmentation/multi-syllable terms nên lowercase+space split không là production analyzer đầy đủ. Analyzer change có thể cần reindex và versioned rollout; test queries nhiều ngôn ngữ, names, IDs và mixed code/text.
paragraphs.en: Index/query analyzers must be compatible, though search-specific synonyms may intentionally differ. Specify normalization, accents, tokenization, language processing and keyword fields. Vietnamese needs more than simple lowercase/space splitting. Version analyzer changes and test multilingual names, identifiers and mixed text.

title.vi: 6. BM25 là retrieval score, không phải relevance truth
title.en: 6. BM25 is a retrieval score rather than relevance truth

paragraphs.vi: Một common teaching formulation cộng theo query terms: IDF=ln(1+(N−df+0,5)/(df+0,5)); contribution=IDF×tf×(k1+1)/(tf+k1×(1−b+b×dl/avgdl)). tf saturation giảm lợi ích spam lặp từ; b điều chỉnh length normalization. Field boosts, norms/compression, term overlap và implementation details có thể đổi absolute score. Lab dùng exact small-corpus arithmetic với k1=1,2, b mặc định0,75, không khẳng định tái tạo mọi Lucene score.
paragraphs.en: A common teaching BM25 sums IDF and saturated term-frequency contributions with length normalization. Saturation limits repetition benefits, and b controls length adjustment. Fields, norms and implementation details affect absolute scores. The lab uses exact small-corpus arithmetic rather than reproduce every Lucene detail.

paragraphs.vi: Lab hiển thị postings/tf/positions, corpus length và per-term score explanation cho query English. Shared corpus statistics làm scores comparable trong fixture. Production document-sharded indexes có local statistics khác nhau; global-stat query phase hoặc calibrated scoring có trade-offs về latency/work. Safe top-K merge theorem chỉ áp khi same fixed score/total order và mỗi shard trả đủ local K; later rerank theo new features có thể cần oversampling để không miss best candidate.
paragraphs.en: Inspect postings and score contributions using shared fixture statistics. Shard-local statistics may differ in production, and global statistics have costs. Exact local-top-K merging assumes comparable fixed scores and sufficient local candidates. Changed reranking features can require larger candidate pools.

caption.vi: BM25 teaching formulation; các biến thuộc cùng field/statistics scope.
caption.en: Teaching BM25 with consistent field/statistics scope.

code.content:
idf(term) = ln(1 + (N - df(term) + 0.5) / (df(term) + 0.5))
norm(d) = k1 * (1 - b + b * length(d) / averageLength)
score(d,q) = sum(idf(t) * tf(t,d) * (k1 + 1) / (tf(t,d) + norm(d)))

N: documents in the chosen statistics scope
df: documents containing the term
k1: nonnegative saturation parameter
b: length normalization in [0,1]

title.vi: 7. Filter trước top-K và kiểm quyền tại hydration
title.en: 7. Filter before top-K and authorize hydration

paragraphs.vi: Nếu top2 gồm private d2 và public d5, lọc d2 sau ranking chỉ còn một result dù public d1 đủ tốt vẫn nằm ngoài pool. Apply ACL/tenant/business filters vào retrieval trước candidate truncation khi cần đúng eligible recall. Rerank/hydrate/cache cũng enforce quyền: stale index ACL có thể cần current-authority validation để đáp ứng strict revocation SLO. Kiểm ở cuối giúp chặn leak nhưng không tự lấy lại authorized candidates đã bỏ; cần refill/retrieval policy rõ.
paragraphs.en: Post-truncation filtering can underfill results and miss eligible candidates. Filter within retrieval before candidate limits, then enforce rights through reranking, hydration and caches. Current-authority checks may be needed for revocation guarantees. Final checks prevent leaks without recovering lost recall unless refill/retrieval explicitly does so.

paragraphs.vi: Cache keys gồm normalized query/filter/sort, effective permission scope/version và index/ranking generation theo freshness contract. Shared popular-query cache không được reuse private snippets giữa tenants. Result counts/facets/suggestions/error timing cũng có disclosure risk; access checks không chỉ hide body text. Snippets escaped/sanitized, highlight markers không được execute source HTML/script. Internal fixture deliberately exposes all toy texts để giải thích algorithms, không là production permission design.
paragraphs.en: Cache keys include effective scopes and coherent query/index/ranking contexts. Protect snippets, counts, facets, suggestions and timing from cross-tenant disclosure. Escape snippets/highlights. Exposed toy corpus text is educational instrumentation rather than a production authorization design.

title.vi: 8. Durability, refresh và merge là ba trục
title.en: 8. Durability, refresh and merge are separate axes

paragraphs.vi: Recoverable ingest/writer acceptance có log/replication/persistence contract riêng. Refresh mở/publish reader mới cho changes searchable, có thể không cần full durable index commit. Merge kết hợp segments và reclaim obsolete bodies/deletion bits dưới reader-safe policy; nó không phải bước bắt buộc trước mỗi durability ACK. Không vẽ một linear pipeline buffer→refresh→merge→fsync như mọi write phải đi qua đủ theo thứ tự đó.
paragraphs.en: Acceptance has its own recovery/persistence contract. Refresh publishes searchable readers without necessarily making a full index commit. Merges combine/reclaim segments while protecting readers, independently of per-write ACKs. Avoid a mandatory linear refresh/merge/fsync model.

paragraphs.vi: Versioned update/delete guard chặn old CDC event sau newer delete. Tombstone/version metadata retention phải cover supported replay/rebuild window, hoặc có authoritative snapshot/reconciliation thay thế. Lab v1 body→v2 delete→refresh→latev1→refresh cho thấy guard-off resurrect; merge reclaim old bytes không tự sửa resurrected current state. Search invisibility không là physical erasure khỏi mọi replica/snapshot/backup.
paragraphs.en: Versioned guards prevent obsolete events from resurrecting deletes. Retain enough metadata for supported replay or use authoritative rebuild protocols. The lab demonstrates how stale updates can resurrect after refresh; merging bytes does not repair incorrect current state. Invisibility differs from universal physical erasure.

paragraphs.vi: Faster refresh có thể tăng small segments/merge work và query tails; choose freshness SLO theo data class/workload. Read-your-write wait token hoặc limited primary overlay có thể phục vụ own edits nhưng overlay cần query/filter/rank/dedup/delete semantics, không chỉ append changed document vào mọi result page. Không hứa globally fresh total ordering khi index còn lag.
paragraphs.en: Faster refresh trades freshness against segments/merge/query costs. Visibility waits or carefully scoped overlays can support own edits, but overlays require correct query/ranking/filter/deletion semantics. They do not automatically establish globally fresh ordering.

title.vi: 9. Tail latency tăng theo fan-out và correlation

paragraphs.vi: Nếu N eligible shards độc lập có per-shard slow probability p, xác suất ít nhất một slow là 1−(1−p)^N. N=100,p=1% cho khoảng63,4%, không phải query p99 cố định63,4%: đây là threshold-event probability tại một slow definition. Shared overload/AZ/network correlation phá independence. Query completion có parse/routing/merge/rerank/hydrate overhead ngoài max shard response; instrument full critical path.
paragraphs.en: Under independence, at-least-one-slow probability is one minus (one minus p) to N. This is a threshold-event model rather than a universal percentile claim. Shared overload violates independence, and coordinator/reranking/hydration add critical-path work beyond shard maxima.

paragraphs.vi: Replicas/load-aware routing có thể giảm tails; bounded hedging gửi replica khác sau delay nếu original còn pending. Extra requests tốn CPU/network và có thể làm overload tệ hơn; use request budgets, correlation-aware routing, cancellation và admission. Deadline có thể fail closed hoặc explicit partial theo product; thiếu shard không được báo complete global top-K/counts/facets. Partial pagination còn cần stable completeness semantics.
paragraphs.en: Replicas and bounded hedges can reduce delays at additional cost. Budget/cancel hedges and account for correlated overload. Deadlines either fail closed or return explicitly incomplete results; missing shards cannot establish complete global rankings/counts or stable pagination.

paragraphs.vi: Lab tách analytical N/p panel khỏi fixed four-shard trace, tránh lấy toy timings làm benchmark. Primary durations30/40/180/55 ms; backup service times90/90/45/90 ms. Hedge delay30 làm slow shard hoàn tất75 ms và tạo thêm3 requests; deadline80 không hedge trả partial3/4 hoặc fail. Chọn latency policy phải nhìn cả quality/completeness và resource amplification.
paragraphs.en: The lab separates analytical probabilities from a fixed four-request trace. Hedge delay thirty reduces its slow request to seventy-five ms with three extra requests; deadline eighty otherwise yields three responses or failure. Evaluate completeness and resource amplification together.

items.vi: Mỗi shard có index của một phần documents; coordinator gửi query tới tập shards có thể chứa kết quả.
items.en: Each shard indexes a document subset; coordinators query shards that may contain results.

items.vi: Giữ intersection/scoring gần dữ liệu; routing có thể prune shards, nhưng broad query vẫn chịu fan-out/tail.
items.en: Keep intersection/scoring near data; routing can prune shards while broad queries still pay fan-out/tail costs.

items.vi: Chỉ cần liên hệ owners của query terms, nhưng broad/popular terms có postings rất lớn và hot owners.
items.en: Contact owners of query terms, but broad/popular terms have large postings and hot owners.

items.vi: Cross-owner intersections cần ship postings hoặc distributed protocol; ít contacted shards không tự đồng nghĩa ít work.
items.en: Cross-owner intersections ship postings or need distributed protocols; fewer contacted shards do not establish lower work.

title.vi: 10. Retrieval, ranking và reranking có recall budgets
title.en: 10. Retrieval, ranking and reranking have recall budgets

paragraphs.vi: Candidate generation dùng lexical/postings hoặc hybrid sources; cheap features/BM25 chọn larger pool; learning-to-rank/neural rerank chỉ xử lý bounded subset. Model không cứu relevant document chưa vào pool. Measure recall theo stage, languages và query intents; tune oversampling/diversity/dedup để không toàn near-duplicate pages. Feature freshness, model version, deterministic ties và timeout fallback là response contract.
paragraphs.en: Retrieval feeds cheap scoring and bounded expensive reranking. Models cannot rescue missing candidates. Measure stage recall across query/language slices and address duplicates/diversity. Feature/model versions, ties and fallback policies affect returned results.

paragraphs.vi: Web corpus thêm link authority/spam/trust/freshness; commerce có availability/price/category và business policies. Learned behavior signals có position/popularity bias và feedback loops; test niche/new items. Score magnitudes giữa lexical/vector/model không mặc định comparable; hybrid normalization/fusion phải có evaluation. RAG dùng retrieved documents còn cần provenance/context constraints được mở sâu ở AI Systems.
paragraphs.en: Web and commerce corpora use different signals and constraints. Behavioral features carry bias and feedback loops. Lexical/vector/model scores are not automatically comparable; evaluate fusion and candidate recall, with RAG-specific context constraints covered separately.

title.vi: Spending relevance compute có chủ đích

caption.vi: Mỗi truncation cần đo relevant candidates bị bỏ.
caption.en: Measure relevant candidates lost at every truncation.

detail.vi: Authorized scope và broad affordable candidates.
detail.en: Retrieve broad affordable eligible candidates.

detail.vi: Comparable scores, bounded per-shard pools.
detail.en: Use comparable scores and bounded pools.

detail.vi: Versioned features/models và fallback.
detail.en: Apply versioned models/features with fallback.

detail.vi: Rights, snippets, quality/freshness slices.
detail.en: Check rights, content and quality/freshness slices.

title.vi: 11. Cursor cần total order và stable reader context
title.en: 11. Cursors need total order and stable readers

paragraphs.vi: Deep offset pagination bắt shards thu thập skipped hits cộng page hits, tăng memory/CPU/merge work. search-after dùng last sort tuple nhưng không freeze updates giữa pages. Point-in-time/snapshot reader cùng deterministic total sort/tiebreaker hỗ trợ consistent traversal; internal doc IDs có thể khác replicas và thay sau merges nên không dùng như universal external identity ngoài supported snapshot scope.
paragraphs.en: Deep offsets collect skipped hits as well as page hits. Search-after reduces this work without freezing updates. Snapshot readers and total sort/tiebreakers support consistent traversal; internal document IDs are not universally stable external identities.

paragraphs.vi: Cursor opaque/signed bind query/filter/principal scope, sort, ranking/index generation và expiry. Snapshot pin giữ old segments gây resource pressure nên bound lifetime/open contexts và cleanup. ACL revoke/delete strictness có thể cần override old snapshot content; product cần nói stable traversal nhưng current rights vẫn enforced như thế nào. Reindex alias switch không silently đổi reader giữa cùng cursor chain; expired context trả reset contract rõ.
paragraphs.en: Bind opaque cursors to contexts and expiry. Reader pins consume resources, requiring limits. Current rights may override snapshot visibility; define that interaction. Reindex switches do not silently mix reader contexts, and expired contexts need explicit restart semantics.

title.vi: 12. NDCG dùng independent judgments, không tự chấm returned pool
title.en: 12. NDCG needs independent judgments beyond returned hits

paragraphs.vi: Giữ judged query set đại diện languages/intents/head-tail và graded relevance, có version/annotation criteria. DCG@K cộng (2^rel−1)/log2(rank+1); IDCG lấy best ordering từ judged candidate universe cho query, không chỉ sort các hits hệ thống vừa trả. Nếu only returned mediocre item được sort làm ideal, metric có thể 1 dù hệ thống miss excellent documents. IDCG=0 cần declared undefined/skip/zero convention và reporting coverage.
paragraphs.en: Maintain representative versioned query judgments. DCG discounts graded gains by rank; ideal gain comes from independently judged possibilities, not only returned hits. Otherwise missing excellent documents can still score perfectly. Declare zero-ideal conventions and judgment coverage.

paragraphs.vi: Ví dụ judgments excellent=3, okay=1, bad=0. Return only okay cho DCG1, nhưng IDCG@2 là 7+1/log2(3), nên NDCG khoảng0,131; không phải1. Offline gates còn cần candidate recall, zero-results, permission correctness, freshness và latency slices. Unjudged không đồng nghĩa chắc irrelevant; track missing labels. Click/reformulation/abandonment trong A/B bị position bias và query-mix effects, nên dùng guardrails/segmentation chứ không tối ưu CTR đơn lẻ.
paragraphs.en: With excellent three, okay one and bad zero, returning only okay yields about 0.131 at two, not one. Evaluate candidate recall, empty results, rights, freshness and latency alongside ranking. Track unjudged coverage and online biases rather than optimize clicks alone.

rows.vi: Relevant results ở đúng vị trí không?
Coverage, annotator consistency và stale labels.
rows.en: Coverage, annotation consistency and stale labels.

rows.vi: Reranker có nhìn thấy best docs không?
rows.en: Can rerankers see the best documents?

rows.vi: Real user outcomes đổi thế nào?
Bias, sample mix và delayed outcomes.
rows.en: Bias, cohort mix and delayed outcomes.

rows.vi: Needs end-to-end probes, không chỉ node health.
rows.en: Needs end-to-end evidence beyond node health.

caption.vi: Tính NDCG@2 trên judgments độc lập; chỉ trả okay vẫn bị phạt vì bỏ sót excellent.
caption.en: Calculate NDCG@2 against independent judgments; returning only okay is penalized for missing excellent.

code.content:
judged relevance: excellent=3, okay=1, bad=0
returned ranking: [okay]
DCG@2  = (2^1 - 1) / log2(2) = 1
IDCG@2 = (2^3 - 1) / log2(2) + (2^1 - 1) / log2(3)
        = 7 + 0.6309297536 = 7.6309297536
NDCG@2 = 1 / 7.6309297536 = 0.131042 approximately

# The unreturned excellent document still belongs to the judged universe.
# Sorting only returned hits would wrongly produce an ideal gain of 1.

paragraphs.vi: New analyzer/mapping/schema generation build từ consistent source cut và compatible versioned tail. Verify document/delete coverage, permissions, queries và performance trước alias/generation switch; pin old pagination readers hoặc expire rõ. Keep old generation có rollback window nhưng không restore revoked content qua unsafe stale aliases. Snapshot/recovery cần indexes, source/version checkpoints và retained tombstone strategy, không chỉ copy segment files rồi đoán latest.
paragraphs.en: Build schema/analyzer generations from coherent cuts and versioned tails, verify coverage/rights/quality and switch readers explicitly. Rollback policies preserve current safety rather than revive revoked content. Recovery includes checkpoints and deletion/version strategy, not just segment files.

paragraphs.vi: Bound query complexity: wildcard/regex/fuzzy expansions, script costs, aggregation cardinality, returned fields/snippet size và per-tenant concurrency. Isolate foreground query pools khỏi refresh/merge/rebuild, nhưng vẫn reserve enough indexing capacity để freshness không chết. Monitor merge backlog/disk temporary space/reader pins/cache churn và hot shards. DLQ malformed ingest giữ source identity/version để repair/replay an toàn.
paragraphs.en: Bound expansions, scripts, aggregations, response sizes and concurrency. Protect queries from maintenance without starving freshness. Monitor temporary space, merges, reader pins, churn and skew. Malformed-ingest remediation retains identities/versions for safe replay.

title.vi: 14. Chứng minh query quality cùng recovery correctness
title.en: 14. Verify query quality together with recovery correctness

paragraphs.vi: Trace ingest accepted→writer applied→reader visible và query parse→eligible shards→candidate merge→rerank→authorized hydration. Report p50/p95/p99 theo query class, shard completeness, source-to-visible lag, deleted/unauthorized result probes, stage recall, zero-result rates và resource cost. Cache-hit rate cao không chứng minh quality/freshness; score lớn không chứng minh relevance.
paragraphs.en: Trace both visibility and query stages. Slice latency, completeness, freshness, forbidden/deleted-result probes, recall, empty results and cost. Cache hits and score magnitudes alone do not establish quality.

paragraphs.vi: Fault tests gồm delayed/stale source updates sau delete, duplicate ingest, shard timeout/replica failover, hedge storm, full disk/merge stall, analyzer rollout mismatch, old PIT expiry và permission revoke trên cached results. Compare against small exact baseline để kiểm postings/ranking/ties/ACL và stable pagination. Review completeness policy bằng missing-shard test, không chỉ all-green cluster.
paragraphs.en: Test stale updates, duplicate ingestion, missing shards, hedges, disk/merge failures, schema mismatches, expired contexts and cached revocations. Small exact baselines validate algorithms and pagination; missing-shard tests validate completeness policies.

items.vi: Exact small corpus, score contributions và independent judged sets.
items.en: Use exact small corpora, contributions and independent judgments.

items.vi: Visibility/deletion versions, permissions và snapshot cursor contexts.
items.en: Verify visibility/deletions, rights and cursor contexts.

items.vi: Partial shards, correlated tails và maintenance resource contention.
items.en: Exercise incomplete shards, correlated delays and maintenance contention.

title.vi: 15. Luyện giải thích từ postings tới response contract
title.en: 15. Explain postings through the response contract

paragraphs.vi: Vẽ query cache redis có private top candidate, slow shard và recent deleted document. Hỏi filter ở đâu, score statistics scope nào, missing shard có làm page complete không và cached snippet còn quyền không. Sau đó paginate qua refresh/reindex và tính NDCG khi excellent document không được retrieve.
paragraphs.en: Trace a query with private candidates, slow shards and recent deletes. Explain filter placement, score scopes, completeness, cached rights and pagination through refreshes, then score a ranking that missed an excellent document.

question.vi: Index/query analyzer có bắt buộc identical không?
question.en: Must index and query analyzers be identical?

answer.vi: Không nhất thiết. Terms/positions/query semantics cần compatible; dedicated search analyzer/synonyms có thể khác có chủ đích. Version và test reindex requirements, nhất là multilingual text.
answer.en: Not necessarily; intentional search-time analysis is valid when compatible and tested.

question.vi: Tại sao filter ACL sau top-K không đủ?

answer.vi: Nó có thể block leak cuối cùng nhưng underfill/miss authorized candidates đã bị truncate. Apply eligible scope trong retrieval và enforce current rights xuyên cache/hydration; refill nếu strict revocation drops candidates.
answer.en: It can prevent final disclosure while losing eligible recall; filter earlier and preserve current rights throughout.

question.vi: Refresh có đồng nghĩa durable fsync commit không?
question.en: Does refresh mean a durable fsync commit?

answer.vi: Không. Refresh publish searchable reader; acceptance/recovery persistence và merge lifecycle khác boundaries. Chọn guarantees bằng storage protocol, không suy từ searchable result.
answer.en: No. Search visibility, persistence and physical lifecycle have distinct guarantees.

question.vi: Shard local top-K merge lúc nào exact?

answer.vi: Khi fixed comparable scores/total order và đủ local K cho global K trên eligible set. Local statistics khác hoặc later rerank thay scoring có thể cần extra protocol/candidate oversampling; missing shard phá completeness.
answer.en: Under comparable fixed scores/order and sufficient local candidates; changed scoring or missing shards alter the guarantee.

question.vi: Hedge luôn làm hệ thống nhanh hơn không?

answer.vi: Không. Extra load/correlation/cancellation delay có thể tăng overload. Budget, measure tails và completeness, choose delay dưới actual capacity; toy min(primary,delay+backup) bỏ nhiều costs.
answer.en: No. Added load and correlation can worsen overload; measure under bounded budgets.

question.vi: search_after có freeze index qua pages không?

answer.vi: Không. Stable reader/PIT cùng total sort/tiebreaker và context binding mới hỗ trợ stable traversal; permission/deletion/expiry policy vẫn phải define.
answer.en: No. Stable readers and total ordering/context binding are additional requirements.

question.vi: NDCG ideal có lấy từ returned hits thôi không?
question.en: Can ideal gain use only returned hits?

answer.vi: Không để đánh giá retrieval/ranking đầy đủ. Cần independent judgments để missing excellent docs bị phạt; handle unjudged và IDCG0 explicit. Return only okay trong worked example không score1.
answer.en: Not for full evaluation; independent judgments penalize missed excellent results and require explicit coverage/zero-gain rules.

question.vi: Delete đã invisible thì merge có thể quên version guard ngay không?
question.en: Can invisible deletes immediately discard version guards?

answer.vi: Không nếu supported replay còn stale updates. Retain version/tombstone metadata hoặc authoritative rebuild/cutoff protocol; physical reclamation không cho phép resurrection.
answer.en: Not while obsolete events can replay; retain enough metadata or authoritative recovery boundaries.
